headline: Mechanical Engineering undergraduate focused on CAD, CAE, manufacturing optimization, robotics, and technical leadership.
summary: Mechanical Engineering student at NSUT with internship experience at Larsen & Toubro and Maruti Suzuki, hands-on work in chassis design, FEA, autonomous systems, and leadership across ASME and IEEE chapters.

highlights: Generated detailed Bills of Materials from AutoCAD drawings for trusses, purlins, and structural steel components.
Implemented KAIZEN and Lean Six Sigma practices to improve welding efficiency by 20-25% and reduce rework by 30%.
Analyzed hydrodynamic flow of the water treatment system to assess operational performance and reliability.
Applied Maynard Operation Sequence Technique (MOST) to optimize Assembly Line-B, reducing fitment time by 27%.
Developed a video-based Work Instruction System for Brezza assembly training.
Designed Suzuki Basic Training Modules covering operator safety, efficiency, and factory process understanding.
